candidate_role: Manifest engine and conditional instant/sorcery recursion
commander_specific_hypothesis: When an instant or sorcery is cast from hand, manifest the top card as a 2/2 creature; that creature can pay casualty 2. If a manifested instant or sorcery dies, Cryptic Pursuit permits casting it until end of next turn.
expected_benefit: Recurring power-2 casualty fodder and conditional spell recovery; complements Talrand and other existing token makers.
tradeoff: Four mana and no immediate body; does not trigger from copies or spells cast from graveyard. Talrand's Invocation provides two flying Drakes immediately and four if copied.
